name: Billy Doe Meats
verdict: Billy Doe Meats delivered a 5.01 ROAS on $1,482.15 in Meta spend over 28 days, generating 39 purchases and $7,422.61 in revenue, but the biggest concern is a sharp 7-day pullback with ROAS down 21.64% and GBP actions dropping 57.82% week-over-week, likely driven by reduced ad spend (down 13.86%) and softening organic visibility. The top campaign "BWS - Sales - Muslims" at $840.44 is carrying the majority of budget, making overall performance heavily dependent on a single campaign's continued efficiency.

performance.verdict: ROAS holds at 5x but single-campaign dependency and GBP collapse need action now.

findings.text: ROAS fell 21.64% in 7d and last 3 days (Sep 11–13) show only 3 purchases vs 8 in prior 3 days (Sep 8–10), confirming a short-term efficiency dip.
5 overdue SOW milestones (Aug 14–31): Live-Cook Shoot, Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership, Funnel Test/UTM, SEO Phase 1 — all unresolved as of Sep 14.
GBP actions hit 0 on Sep 12 and Sep 13 (down from 21–25/day prior week), a 57.82% 7d drop — organic local visibility has effectively gone dark.
57% of 28-day spend ($840.44 of $1,482.15) sits in one campaign 'BWS - Sales - Muslims'; no second campaign provides a safety net if this fatigues.

IG reach fell 17.8% 7d and 3-day avg (Sep 11–13: 724) is below prior 3-day avg (Sep 8–10: 649 — wait, Sep 8–10: 625, 503, 738 = 622 avg vs Sep 11–13: 625, 581, 967 = 724 avg); reach is actually recovering slightly — fatigue risk is probable, not confirmed, given flat spend.

suggestions.text: Monitor ROAS daily for 3 more days; if purchases stay below 2/day, trigger creative refresh on BWS Muslims campaign.
suggestions.monday_update: ROAS dropped 21.64% in 7 days and the last 3 days (Sep 11–13) produced only 3 purchases vs 8 in the prior 3-day window. No budget move is warranted yet — one campaign ('BWS - Sales - Muslims' at $840.44/28d) carries 57% of spend and needs confirmation of trend before action. If daily purchases remain below 2 for Sep 14–16, escalate to a creative refresh on that campaign. Re-check Sep 17.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP profile — 2 consecutive zero-action days (Sep 12–13) after 20+ daily average; flag to Nacer for manual check.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero on both Sep 12 and Sep 13, against a prior 7-day average of ~20+ actions/day and a 57.82% week-over-week drop. This is an organic local visibility failure that no paid spend change will fix. Nacer to manually check the GBP profile for suspension flags, missing hours, or listing issues by Sep 16. Success is confirmed when daily GBP actions return above 15 by Sep 19.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue milestones (oldest Aug 14) to Nacer; Funnel Test/UTM closure directly blocks attribution accuracy and scaling decisions.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are overdue as of Sep 14, the oldest dating to Aug 14 (Live-Cook Shoot). The most critical is 'Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live' (due Aug 31) — without it, Meta purchase attribution via Windsor remains unvalidated and no confident scale decision can be made on the 5.01 ROAS figure. Nacer to triage all five this week and assign hard re-open dates. Success check: at least the Funnel Test and UTM milestone marked complete or rescheduled with owner by Sep 19.
